title: Lanewise's model catalog
description: Describes the models each Model Provider's live model list returns: which family and version each model ID is, and the Effort levels it takes (PRD §8.3). The live lists decide which models exist; this only describes them. See catalog/README.md.

format.description: The catalog's format. A Lanewise that doesn't know it keeps the copy it was built with.

providers.description: Each Model Provider's models, by the catalog section its adapter names.

pattern.description: A regular expression, matched against the whole model ID: it needs no ^ or $.

effort.description: An Effort level, as the picker names it: Off, Minimal, Low, Medium, High, Extra high or Maximum.

exclude.description: Model IDs the list returns that can't be chatted with, such as image, speech and embedding models. They aren't offered at all.

families.description: The models the picker offers, in the order it offers them.

id.description: Kept in Settings as the model chosen, so it must not change. Unique within its Model Provider, and never other-versions.

versions.description: Newest first. A model ID is described by the first version, in any family, whose pattern it matches.

examples.description: Model IDs this version describes, which the tests check it matches first.

name.description: The version's name, where the Model Provider's list gives none. Without one, the list's name or the model ID is shown.

efforts.description: The Effort levels it takes, least first. Empty where it takes none. Where the Model Provider's list reports its own levels, as Anthropic's does, those are offered instead.

defaultEffort.description: The Model Provider's own default among efforts, or null where it takes none or its default isn't one of them, such as Gemini 2.5's dynamic thinking.

budgets.description: For a model that takes a token budget rather than a level, such as Gemini 2.5: the budget each of efforts is sent as, and no other.
